system.description: While you are in Spear Form, once per turn, as part of dealing damage with a melee Ninjutsu or Taijutsu attack that deals Lightning damage, you can spend 3 Voltage. If you do, you release a spike of electrical energy from your strike, forcing the target to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take an additional 2d6 lightning damage and are also Dazed, or half as much on a success. Beginning at 7th level, increase the bonus damage to 4d6 and the target is also Staggered. Beginning at 15th level, increase the bonus damage to 6d6 and lightning damage you deal as part of the triggering attack and this Circuit ignores resistance and treat immunity as resistance.
